description: Use this when a user wants a first-pass readiness check for French/EU pay transparency obligations before requesting an PariteCK demo. country and headcount are required — the tool rejects the call (rather than guessing) if they are missing or mis-named, so obligation applicability is never inferred from incomplete input.

country.description: Company country, for example France. Required.

hasCseReporting.description: Whether CSE/NAO reporting evidence is already assembled.

hasJobFamilies.description: Whether equivalent-value job families/categories are mapped.

hasPayrollExport.description: Whether payroll export or DSN data is available.

headcount.description: Approximate employee count (positive whole number). Required.

name: assess_readiness
